season_stat_feats.label: MLB season feats (no-hitter, perfect game, 20-win season, 20-K game, 500-ft HR, 4-HR game, grand-slam game, 50/50)
season_stat_feats.target: Whether any player or pitcher achieves a rare league-wide season feat (individual no-hitter, perfect game, 20 wins, 20 strikeouts in a game, 500-foot home run, 4-home-run game, 2-grand-slam game, 50 home runs and 50 steals) by season end.
season_stat_feats.why_distinct: League-wide rare-event hazards over about 2,430 games plus individual season-accumulation thresholds (wins, HR and SB), unlike a named pitcher's maximum velocity.

player_home_run_exposure.label: MLB named-hitter home-run exposure over a series or date window
player_home_run_exposure.target: Whether a named hitter records at least N home runs across a playoff series or at least one home run inside a fixed date window.
player_home_run_exposure.why_distinct: A multi-game exposure count for one hitter (expected plate appearances, per-PA home-run rate, lineup and series-length uncertainty), not a postseason league total or a single-game hitter prop.

pitcher_scoreless_innings_streak.label: MLB pitcher consecutive scoreless innings streak
pitcher_scoreless_innings_streak.target: Whether a named pitcher reaches N consecutive scoreless innings from a streak start through the end of the regular season.
pitcher_scoreless_innings_streak.why_distinct: A streak-survival process: per-inning scoreless probability compounding over remaining starts and innings per start, with the streak ending at the first run, unlike a counting threshold.
